smallest_counterexample: One accepted job plus a second queued URL repeatedly returning 429 is enough: 40 bounded requests produce zero polls and advance only the fake clock by 35100 seconds.
minimal_correction: Use deque, independent submission and poll deadlines, explicit pending/success/error/uncertain/deferred states, Retry-After and finite attempt/poll ceilings. Poll due work first. Treat ambiguous submission outcomes as uncertain and defer new work for reconciliation instead of blind resubmission.
limitations: The reference passed 1512 bounded scripted state combinations; this is finite model coverage, not proof for arbitrary responses or concurrent remote clients.
429 definitively rejects only by the synthetic protocol assumption. 503/missing job IDs may mean accepted work; unknown outcomes close admission while existing polls continue.
Actual IA quota, concurrency, if_not_archived_within behavior, persistence/recovery and exactly-once remote execution remain NOT_TESTED.
record_result is unspecified in the source: deletion of unknown status is proven, but calling every recorded result a success would overstate the evidence.
